```{=html}
<script id="landing-install-tabs" type="text/javascript">
  /**
   * @license MIT
   * @copyright 2026 Mickaël Canouil
   * @author Mickaël Canouil
   */
  // Hovering or focusing an install button shows the matching command tab.
  // Bootstrap's Tab.show() is used instead of a click so the choice is not
  // saved to Quarto's persistent tabset state.
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.landing-install .nav-link');
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-landing-tab]').forEach((button) => {
      const tab = Array.from(tabs).find(
        (link) => link.textContent.trim() === button.dataset.landingTab,
      );
      if (!tab) {
        console.warn(
          `landing-install-tabs: no install tab is labelled "${button.dataset.landingTab}".`,
        );
        return;
      }
      const show = () => bootstrap.Tab.getOrCreateInstance(tab).show();
      button.addEventListener('mouseenter', show);
      button.addEventListener('focus', show);
    });
  });
</script>
```
